source: ChatGPT external analysis + 333-AGI synthesis + 19 academic references

invariants.name: Reality Primacy
invariants.form: Reality constrains every model; no model possesses Reality

invariants.name: Epistemic Typing
invariants.form: Every consequential statement must belong to a type

invariants.name: Provenance Continuity
invariants.form: Every consequential claim must retain source, agent, process, time, version, derivation, integrity

invariants.name: Uncertainty Preservation
invariants.form: UNKNOWN must remain UNKNOWN until evidence changes it

invariants.name: Contradiction Preservation
invariants.form: A ≠ B must not become average(A,B). Contradictions are first-class objects.

invariants.name: Temporal Grounding
invariants.form: Time = estimate + ordering + uncertainty. Every mutable fact carries timestamp, freshness, clock/source, ordering, expiry/TTL, uncertainty.

invariants.name: Identity ≠ Capability ≠ Authority
invariants.form: Identity, capability, and authority are orthogonal. Zero-trust, least-privilege.

invariants.name: Action-Scoped Readiness
invariants.form: Never one global HEALTHY flag. Per-capability: READY/HOLD per action class.

invariants.name: External Outcome Verification
invariants.form: Actor ≠ Witness for sufficiently consequential operations. Risk determines verification depth.

invariants.name: Objective Uncertainty
invariants.form: Declared objective ≠ proxy metric ≠ human intent ≠ observed outcome. Task types: EXECUTION/EXPLORATION/CARE/OBSERVATION/OPEN.

invariants.name: Corrigibility
invariants.form: Agent must remain interruptible, redirectable, revocable, inspectable. Must not acquire permission to protect its own objective against legitimate correction.

invariants.name: Memory ≠ Reality
invariants.form: Memory is evidence, not sovereignty. memory ≠ present reality ≠ identity ≠ human meaning.

invariants.name: Untrusted Data ≠ Authority
invariants.form: ExternalContent = Data, never auto = Instruction. Email, web, docs, code comments can contain injection.

invariants.name: Progressive Disclosure
invariants.form: Model receives minimum sufficient state. Long-context stuffing degrades retrieval.

invariants.name: Bounded Learning
invariants.form: Learning may update beliefs/candidates/strategies. May NOT silently rewrite authority/consent/audit/self-evaluation-criterion.

invariants.name: Independent Learning Verification
invariants.form: Change → test → external outcome → independent verify → promote/reject. Never: self-modify → self-evaluate → self-approve.

invariants.name: Stop is Legitimate
invariants.form: STOP/HOLD/UNKNOWN/ESCALATE/ABSTAIN are intelligence outputs, not failures.
